title: 第八章 五楼第九章 通关
content_zh:
回到屋里，拿起烛火，周游第三次走出这扇房门。
那斩骨刀绞肉机和电烙铁就放在眼前，不过他依旧没想着去动——反正五楼还没去过，他打算先去探查一下再说。
毕竟不到万不得已的情况下，这世上没谁会乐意硬生生切开自己的身体。
在身上摸索了半天，周游从上衣口袋里找出一盒火柴，重新点燃蜡烛，接着迈向楼梯。
一步，两步，三步，四步.......一直到四楼时，蜡烛都没任何变化，但就在他再度踏上通往五楼的台阶时，一直以来温吞的烛火却忽然一晃，接着便仿佛加入了助燃剂一般，猛烈无比地开始燃烧了起来！
只是周游并没有着急跑，而是先转过身，看了一眼身后。
那畸形的手和脸已经从对联中探出，但和上一回不同，它们仿佛根本看不到近在咫尺的周游一般，只是茫然无措地来回飘荡。
“看起来这东西是即时起效，而且确实能完全屏蔽掉四楼这对联的感知，只是不知道对那房东太太是否有用.....算了，这事之后在考虑，现在最主要的是......”
周游看着那张空洞的脸庞，深吸一口气，将满是灰尘的空气灌入肺部，接着一反刚才的冷静，全力向五楼跑去！
十米不到的楼梯转瞬即过。五楼是这个居民楼的阁楼，只有一扇房门，上面挂着一把沉重的老式大锁。
周游将那把从房东太太身上顺来....哦不对，是拾来的钥匙捅进锁孔，试了好几次，才勉强将已经快锈死的卡簧打开。
锁头砰然落地，发出一阵沉闷的响声，周游也不在乎这动静是否会引来房东——反正等它赶过来这蜡烛也基本快燃尽了，到时候被四楼干掉还是被它干掉都没啥太大区别——然后用力推开陈旧的木门。
伴随着刺耳的‘吱呀’声，那逃生的路线也终于向他展开！
但旋即，周游却突兀地愣住。
不，并不是说他见到了什么令人绝望的场景，比如根本没逃生出口之类的——事实上如果真是死路的话，以他的性格也只会先啐上一口接着朝书页竖上一根中指再另找它法。之所以愣住是因为别的原因。
他看到了尸体。
而且，不是一具。
是很多很多的尸体。
就在周游眼前，层层叠叠的人尸就这么挂在阁楼的屋顶，初看时至少得有近百具——而且每一具尸体的胸腔都被彻底刨开，其中所有的内脏都不翼而飞，只剩下干瘪犹如枯木般的肉块和骨梁。
而且不知道经过什么处理，这么多的尸体中居然没有多少腐烂的，近乎所有人的面孔都定格于死亡的那一瞬间：恐惧，哀求，绝望，愤怒，崩溃.......

哪怕以周游的心理素质，在这么多双死人眼睛的凝视下，他也感到浑身汗毛倒竖。
毫无疑问，这些全部都是租客——因为交不起租金，而被那个‘房东太太’给活生生解剖，拆碎，贩卖掉的租客。
在那些尸体中，周游甚至还看到了几个明显矮于他人，面容稚嫩的身影。
这是何等的.....
周游闭上眼睛，无声的咬下嘴唇。
但很快的，他还是压下多余的思绪，继续自己的行动。
——蜡烛已经快燃完，现在他需要抓紧时间。
周游就此走进阁楼，但是就在迈进去的瞬间，他脸色忽然再次一变。
一股奇怪的味道涌入鼻腔，那感觉就像是在烈日下放置了三天的臭鸡蛋一般，同时伴随而来的还有些许的眩晕和缺氧感。
从小在农村长大的周游很快就辨识出了这是什么。
沼气，并且还是浓度不低的沼气
content_en:
Return to the house, pick up the candle, and walk out of the door for the third time.
The bone-chopping knife, meat grinder and electric soldering iron were right in front of him, but he still didn't want to move them - he hadn't been to the fifth floor anyway, so he planned to explore them first.
After all, no one in this world would be willing to cut open his or her own body unless absolutely necessary.
After groping around for a long time, Zhou You found a box of matches from his coat pocket, relit the candle, and walked towards the stairs.
One step, two steps, three steps, four steps... until he reached the fourth floor, the candle did not change at all. But when he stepped on the steps to the fifth floor again, the candle that had been tepid suddenly flickered, and then began to burn violently as if it had been added with accelerant!
But Zhou You didn't run in a hurry. Instead, he turned around and glanced behind him.
The deformed hands and face have been poked out of the couplet, but unlike the last time, they seem to be unable to see what is so close at hand, and are just floating back and forth in a daze.
"It seems that this thing is effective immediately, and it can indeed completely block the perception of the couplet on the fourth floor. I just don't know if it will be useful to the landlady... Forget it, I will consider this later, the most important thing now is..."
Zhou You looked at that empty face, took a deep breath, poured the dusty air into his lungs, and then, contrary to his previous calmness, ran towards the fifth floor with all his strength!
The stairs less than ten meters passed by in an instant. The fifth floor is the attic of this residential building. There is only one door with a heavy old-fashioned lock hanging on it.
Zhou You took the key he had picked up from the landlady and inserted it into the keyhole. After trying several times, he managed to open the almost rusty circlip.
The lock slammed to the ground, making a dull sound. Zhou You didn't care whether the movement would attract the landlord - anyway, the candle would be almost burned out by the time it came over, and it wouldn't make much difference whether it was killed by the fourth floor or not - and then he pushed open the old wooden door.
With a harsh 'squeak' sound, the escape route finally opened to him!
But immediately, Zhou You was suddenly stunned.
No, it's not that he saw a desperate scene, such as no escape exit at all - in fact, if it were a dead end, with his character, he would just spit out his mouth and then raise his middle finger to the page before looking for another way. The reason why I was stunned was for other reasons.
He saw the body.
Moreover, it’s not just one body.
There were many, many corpses.
Right in front of Zhou You, layers of human corpses were hanging on the roof of the attic. At first glance, there must have been at least nearly a hundred corpses - and the chest cavity of each corpse had been completely opened, and all the internal organs were missing, leaving only shriveled pieces of flesh and bone beams like dead wood.
And I don’t know what kind of processing has been done, but there are not many rotten corpses among so many corpses. The faces of almost everyone are fixed at the moment of death: fear, pleading, despair, anger, collapse...
Even with his wandering mentality, he felt like the hairs on his body stood on end under the gaze of so many pairs of dead eyes.
There is no doubt that these are all tenants - tenants who were dissected alive, dismantled and sold by the 'landlady' because they could not pay the rent.
Among the corpses, Zhou You even saw a few figures who were obviously shorter than others and had childish faces.
How...
Zhou You closed his eyes and bit his lower lip silently.
But soon, he suppressed his unnecessary thoughts and continued his actions.
——The candle was almost burned out, and now he needed to hurry up.
Zhou You walked into the attic, but the moment he walked in, his expression suddenly changed again.
A strange smell poured into the nose, it felt like being under the scorching sunIt felt like a rotten egg that had been left for three days, accompanied by a slight feeling of dizziness and lack of oxygen.
Zhou You, who grew up in a rural area, quickly recognized what this was.
Biogas, and the concentration of biogas is not low
